detailed_descriptions.en: Start with a small plot of land and a handful of crops. Grow fresh produce, process them into valuable goods, automate your production lines, and stock your own store shelves. As your business expands, you'll unlock new technologies, optimize workflows, and transform a humble farm into a successful farm business. 🌱 Grow Your Farm Plant and harvest a variety of crops across compact, highly efficient farming plots. Improve productivity with better tools, equipment, and farming techniques. ⚙️ Automate Production Turn raw harvests into profitable products using automated machines and production lines. Design efficient workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and maximize output as your operation grows. 🛒 Run Your Own Store Automatically Manage a charming farm shop where customers come to buy your products. Set prices, organize displays, keep shelves stocked, and expand your business to attract more shoppers. 📈 Optimize Your Business Balance farming, manufacturing, and retail operations. Invest profits into automation, unlock upgrades, and continuously improve efficiency to build a successful business. 🧑‍🌾 Meet Special Visitors As your farm grows, unique characters will come to visit. They will offer helpful guidance and special quests that support your progress, helping you unlock new opportunities and develop your farm further.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Start with a small plot of land and a handful of crops. Grow fresh produce, process them into valuable goods, automate your production lines, and stock your own store shelves. As your business expands, you'll unlock new technologies, optimize workflows, and transform a humble farm into a successful farm business.

🌱 Grow Your Farm

Plant and harvest a variety of crops across compact, highly efficient farming plots. Improve productivity with better tools, equipment, and farming techniques.

⚙️ Automate Production

Turn raw harvests into profitable products using automated machines and production lines. Design efficient workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and maximize output as your operation grows.

🛒 Run Your Own Store Automatically

Manage a charming farm shop where customers come to buy your products. Set prices, organize displays, keep shelves stocked, and expand your business to attract more shoppers.

📈 Optimize Your Business

Balance farming, manufacturing, and retail operations. Invest profits into automation, unlock upgrades, and continuously improve efficiency to build a successful business.

🧑‍🌾 Meet Special Visitors

As your farm grows, unique characters will come to visit. They will offer helpful guidance and special quests that support your progress, helping you unlock new opportunities and develop your farm further.
